d: Could Germany become the next major force in international football? Former Liverpool manager Jurgen Klopp's arrival as Germany head coach has brought fresh belief to a national team searching for an identity after years of disappointment. The 5-0 win against the Netherlands in the UEFA Nations League has added to the excitement, but Klopp's bigger challenge involves rebuilding the squad, trusting young players and creating a stronger team culture. Rupha Ramani examines Germany's revival, the Klopp effect and the road to UEFA Euro 2028 and the FIFA World Cup 2030.
